domain: General Statistics & Data Science (data integration, record linkage and entity resolution)

distractor_reasons.wellhaven_daily_weather_2026q4.csv: Wellhaven's daily temperatures, rain and snow for the period: the weather behind the season's ridership and the pay stations' cold-weather faults, which no station's availability, sales or card downtime is computed from
distractor_reasons.northlane_wellhaven_quarterly_report_202: Northlane's quarterly report to the City: monthly trips, casual trips, fleet moves and fault reports for the whole system, and the quarter's operations notes; it states no station's availability, sales or downtime

sources.constructed: every file is constructed for this task by its generator (task482/generator); the City of Wellhaven, its bike-share stations, the operator Northlane Mobility, the pay-station vendor, their staff and every number in the files are fictional
sources.public_specifications: the station status archive follows the General Bikeshare Feed Specification (GBFS 2.3) station_status and station_information fields; the trip export, fleet moves log, rider fault reports, pay-station sales export, alarm log, work orders and asset register follow the layouts bike-share operators and kiosk vendors commonly publish or hand to their cities
